ns2:section.sectionText: German-Jewish Literature and Culture Historical overview of German-Jewish literature with a focus on the literature of the 20th century. We also explore current research on anti-Semitism. The course analyzes and discusses various texts from different genres, paying attention to the historical, social, and political contexts in which the texts were produced. And, we investigate the literary strategies and techniques that affirm or undermine anti-Semitic ideas. Readings and discussions in English. Meets with GER 575, CWL 551, JS 551.
